incidents.text: It's in the back of the net! Keito Nakamura picks out Daichi Kamada (Japan) with a sweet pass, and he latches on to it deep inside the box and beats the goalkeeper. 0:1.

What a beautiful moment! Ayase Ueda (Japan) got to the ball and unleashed a strong shot from distance. It turned out to be a good decision as his effort found its way into the bottom left corner. Aymen Dahmen just shakes his head in disbelief. The score changes to 0:2.
There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Herve Renard probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Elias Saad (Tunisia). He is replaced by Ismael Gharbi.
Here is a change. Dylan Bronn is going off and Herve Renard gives the last tactical orders to Mohamed Ben Hamida (Tunisia).
Sebastian Tounekti goes off the pitch and Firas Chaouat (Tunisia) comes on.
Goal! Ayase Ueda displays great vision and sends a pass to Junya Ito (Japan), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the bottom right corner. The score is 0:3.
Substitution. Daichi Kamada did his best and is replaced by Junnosuke Suzuki (Japan).
Hajime Moriyasu decides to make a substitution. Ritsu Doan will be replaced by Yukinari Sugawara (Japan).
Here's the change. Keito Nakamura leaves the pitch and Yuito Suzuki (Japan) comes on as a substitute.
Hajime Moriyasu prepares a substitution. Takehiro Tomiyasu is replaced by Ayumu Seko (Japan).
Ayase Ueda (Japan) leaps to meet an excellent cross and steers a fantastic header past the goalkeeper, inside the right post.
Substitution. Keisuke Goto (Japan) on for Ayase Ueda.
The manager has decided to make a substitution and Ali Abdi walks off the pitch to be replaced by Elias Achouri (Tunisia).
Herve Renard has decided to substitute Ellyes Skhiri and he is replaced by Rani Khedira (Tunisia).
